page.overview:
Who is Dellen Aphra?

Dellen Aphra was a human female individual who was the daughter of Korin Aphra. She was therefore also the half-sister of Korin's daughter Chelli Lona Aphra, a rogue archeologist who had been born to Korin and his wife Lona. During the New Republic Era, Dellen aligned herself with the New Republic, operating under the code name Aeturna. After their sister was recruited into the New Republic's Department of Artifacts and Archival Goods Retrieval, Dellen had Chelli's electro-tattoos deactivated, preventing Chelli from using them.

Dellen Aphra was first pictured on a variant cover for the first issue of the 2025 comic series Star Wars. The cover was illustrated by Annie Wu and published by Marvel Comics on May 7, 2025. She was identified as Dellen in the of the fourth issue of the 2025 comic series Star Wars: Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent. The issue was written by Cherish Chen and published by Marvel on September 24 of the same year. Dellen later appeared, and was identified with her surname Aphra in the series' fifth issue. The issue was written by Chen, illustrated by Steven Cummings, and published by Marvel
